$comment: Reading a client certificate, shared by tests/shared/certfp.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. SASL EXTERNAL was implemented in both clients and offered in the desktop's server dialog, and neither had anywhere to put a certificate — so the connection presented none and the server had nothing to look up. The certificate here is a real one, generated for the test; its key is public and belongs to nobody.
$certificate: A real self-signed certificate and its key, and the SHA-256 fingerprint openssl computes for it — which is the string a network's NickServ wants.
$cases: is what somebody pasted.  and  say what came out of it;  is what to tell them when it will not do.
